newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c bank sells HRK 150 mln bills, rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c bank sells HRK 150 mln bills, rates flat.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 150 million kuna in 35- and 91-day bills on Wednesday.
Volume rose from 83 million issued at last week's auction, but rates remained unchanged.
The 35-day bills were issued at 8.0 percent on volume of 148 million kuna. The rest was sold in 91-day paper at 9.5 percent.
There were no bids for 182-day bills, last issued at 17.50 percent.
Monday's reserve payment totalled 3.32 billion kuna, up slightly from a forthnight ago, as the banks' deposits rose, a bank official told Reuters.
